capabilities.name: core.runtime
capabilities.description: The language-neutral DLUMA runtime and owner model are available.

capabilities.name: core.timers
capabilities.description: Owner-bound game-thread timers are available.

capabilities.name: world.find
capabilities.description: Exact-name world object lookup is validated for the running build.

capabilities.name: world.local_enable
capabilities.description: Local object enable state can be read and changed.

capabilities.name: world.position
capabilities.description: Copied object transforms can be read.

capabilities.name: player.read
capabilities.description: A generation-bound local-player handle and allowlisted variables are available.

capabilities.name: player.transform
capabilities.description: Copied local-player position and directions can be read.

capabilities.name: player.vitals
capabilities.description: Validated local-player health and alive-state access is available.

capabilities.name: player.vehicle
capabilities.description: Copied local-player vehicle state is available for the running exact build.

capabilities.name: events.sensor
capabilities.description: Named sensor state and edge events are available.

capabilities.name: events.interact
capabilities.description: Validated interaction observations are available.

capabilities.name: events.enemy_killed
capabilities.description: Copied post-death events are available.

capabilities.name: ui.subtitles
capabilities.description: Loader-owned subtitle presentation is available.

capabilities.name: ui.quest_hud
capabilities.description: Copied quest HUD state and presentation-only overrides are available.

capabilities.name: ui.overlay
capabilities.description: Loader overlay widgets are available.

capabilities.name: audio.radio_dialog
capabilities.description: Named radio-dialog playback is available.

capabilities.name: audio.registered_cues
capabilities.description: Registered 2D and positional cue playback is available.

capabilities.name: audio.stem
capabilities.description: Owner-bound companion stem playback is available.

capabilities.name: audio.wave_filter
capabilities.description: Exact-build per-wave wet-mix and cutoff control is available.

capabilities.name: audio.music_exclusive
capabilities.description: Transactional exclusive ownership of stock music is available.

capabilities.name: audio.music_filter
capabilities.description: Exact-build restorable stock-music filter control is available.

capabilities.name: quests.native
capabilities.description: Validated native quest transitions are available.

capabilities.name: quests.phase_handlers
capabilities.description: Manifest-declared custom quest phase providers and observers can receive copied local phase-entry events.

capabilities.name: actions.chain
capabilities.description: Exact-name authored ActionChain execution is available.

capabilities.name: configuration.mod
capabilities.description: Typed manifest-declared mod configuration is available.

capabilities.name: storage.mod
capabilities.description: Owner-isolated persistent scalar storage is available.

capabilities.name: companion.content
capabilities.description: Approval-bound companion content snapshots are available.

capabilities.name: ui.surface
capabilities.description: Owner-bound RGBA HUD surfaces are available for the current game build.

capabilities.name: actions.mod_handlers
capabilities.description: Named mod handlers can be registered and invoked.

capabilities.name: hud.visibility
capabilities.description: Authored HUD targets can be shown, hidden, and restored.

capabilities.name: hud.position
capabilities.description: Supported authored XUI elements can be moved to a relative position.

capabilities.name: actions.infection_flashback
capabilities.description: The local player can request a stock infection flashback.

capabilities.name: hud.visual
capabilities.description: Supported authored XUI elements accept immediate opacity and view color changes.

capabilities.name: hud.text_key
capabilities.description: A supported XUI text element can receive a localization key.

capabilities.name: hud.animation
capabilities.description: A supported XUI timeline can start a named animation.

capabilities.name: hud.document
capabilities.description: A project-owned HUD document can be replaced and restored.

capabilities.name: hud.flashback_textures
capabilities.description: The authored flashback texture aliases can be replaced and restored.
